name: Character Sheet Studio
tagline: Build a full character sheet in one batch — front, side, back, expressions and poses, priced before you generate.
description: Character Sheet Studio turns one character into a complete model sheet. Define the character once (description, traits, trigger words, an optional reference portrait), pair them with a model + LoRA stack, then generate the panels a sheet needs — front, side, back, three-quarter, expressions, poses, details — as one batch. Every run is priced in Buzz before anything is submitted, sheets resume if you leave mid-run, and any finished panel can be posted straight to your Civitai profile. Characters, stacks, and sheets persist in your private library.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Runs image generations on the user's behalf, spending from the per-generation Buzz budget the page grants.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage: Saves and loads the viewer's own characters, model stacks, sheets and settings in a private collection that only that viewer can read.
scopeJustifications.posts:write:self: Publishes a Civitai post to the viewer's own profile from images they generated in this app, only when they tap Post and approve the host's per-post confirmation.
